description: Arachchikattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha - Decision made to execute the By-laws relating to the Housing Property Development and Sale of Allotments of land within the Arachchikattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha Limits
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the imposition of a by-law (pertaining to the Development of Housing Property and Sale of Block Lands) under the Local Authorities (Standard By-Laws) Act. It involves regulatory matters, references to existing legislation (Act No. 06 of 1952, Act No. 15 of 1987), and the official publication of legal determinations. While it mentions government officials (Secretary, Minister), it does so only in the context of their legal authority to enact regulations, not for personnel changes or detailed portfolio assignments. The core content is regulatory/legal in nature, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
